name: Festival Stone of Morntide
title: Festival Stone of Morntide
summary: One of the Empyrean Festival Stones, which 'overlooks the surrounding plains from a hill west of Nanto's Blue Ghost Falls' (Alatar Locke). In the kit, the Festival Stone with its Anniversary Effect glow stands on a flat grassy hilltop at z 157, flanked by two moss-green Master's Sentinel candles. It is 500 m west of the falls that nanto.01 dives.

landmarks.name: Festival Stone
landmarks.note: With the Anniversary Effect at z 165.

site.name: Festival Stone of Morntide
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer morningtide-festival-stone (outdoor, on the hilltop 12 m south-east of the stone). The acpedia map point (53.1S 78.1E) is 120 m west of the stone, down the slope. Landblocks west of x 43008 and south of y 11520 are missing from the kit: cameras stay on the hilltop.

shots.standingOrder: Hold on the hilltop west-south-west of the Festival Stone of Morntide with the moss-green Master's Sentinel candle sharp in the foreground, then pull focus to the glowing stone between the two candles; no move beyond a 0.5 m drift.
